text: 中国央行：10月末，本外币存款余额358.81万亿元，同比增长7.8%。月末人民币存款余额350.65万亿元，同比增长7.7%。 前十个月人民币存款增加21.97万亿元。其中，住户存款增加8.47万亿元，非金融企业存款增加1.91万亿元，财政性存款增加3.03万亿元，非银行业金融机构存款增加5.99万亿元。 10月末，外币存款余额1.22万亿美元，同比增长16.9%。前十个月外币存款增加1553亿美元。
text_en: PBOC: At end-October, outstanding deposits in local and foreign currencies totaled RMB 358.81 trillion, up 7.8% year-on-year. At end-October, outstanding RMB deposits stood at RMB 350.65 trillion, up 7.7% year-on-year. In the first ten months, RMB deposits increased by RMB 21.97 trillion. Of this, household deposits rose by RMB 8.47 trillion, non-financial corporate deposits by RMB 1.91 trillion, fiscal deposits by RMB 3.03 trillion, and deposits of non-bank financial institutions by RMB 5.99 trillion. At end-October, outstanding foreign currency deposits totaled USD 1.22 trillion, up 16.9% year-on-year. In the first ten months, foreign currency deposits increased by USD 155.3 billion.
